info.title: Faclab API
info.description:
The public API of Faclab for integrations: a contract of its own, versioned in
the URL, that doesn't change with the application's frontend.

- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 client credentials at `POST /api/oauth/token`
  with the client's id and secret; the access token lasts 15 minutes. Each
  route requires a scope.
- **Tenant and branch:** the company comes from the token. A client may be
  limited to some branches; `X-Branch-Id` names the branch of an operation.
- **Format:** JSON in camelCase. Money and quantities are decimal strings
  (`"12.50"`), never floating point numbers; timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC.
- **Lists:** `limit` (up to 200) and `offset`, always in a stable order (the id
  breaks ties), `sort` among the fields of each resource, and `updatedSince`
  to sync.
- **Retries:** every POST requires `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID per operation):
  repeating it returns the same response, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.
- **Limits:** per client and per company; over them, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with
  `Retry-After`. Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`,
  `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` and `RateLimit-Policy`.
- **Errors:** `{"errors": [{"code", "message", "field"?}], "meta"}` with codes
  of a stable catalog. Clients must ignore fields they don't know: new ones
  are added without a new version.

get.description:
The active branches this client may operate in (any scope), each with
its active emission points and the active locations of its warehouses:
a sale names one of each (`emissionPointId`, `locationId`) and the
branch in `X-Branch-Id`.

403.description: **Not allowed**: the token lacks the route's scope (`INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`), is not an integration's (`PERMISSION_DENIED`) or names a branch the client may not operate in (`BRANCH_ACCESS_DENIED`).

post.description:
Create a product with its base presentation (its unit, factor 1 and
`barcode`). A SKU or barcode already taken: `PRODUCT_SKU_ALREADY_EXISTS`
or `PRODUCT_BARCODE_ALREADY_EXISTS` (409); a construction material with
another VAT than 5%: `CONSTRUCTION_MATERIAL_TAX_MISMATCH`. Requires
`Idempotency-Key`.

post.description:
Create a sale of channel `api` and confirm it in one step, in the
branch of `X-Branch-Id`, at its emission point `emissionPointId` and
taking the stock of its location `locationId` (see `GET /branches`).
It is numbered in its branch and sent to be invoiced.

Each line takes the price its lists give (the customer's, the branch's
or the general one); another `unitPrice` needs `overrideReason`
(`OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED`) and is audited. The stock must cover it
(`INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`). The sale arrives paid online: `CREDIT_CARD`,
`DEBIT_CARD`, `TRANSFER` or `OTHER`, never cash nor credit,
adding up to its total with VAT exactly (`INSUFFICIENT_PAYMENT`,
`PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE`). Without `customer`, it is sold to the final
consumer. Requires `Idempotency-Key`: a retry with it gets the same
sale, made once.

post.description:
Cancel a sale this client created (`PERMISSION_DENIED` for any
other): its stock goes back where it left from. Only before its invoice
is on its way: while faclab-invoicing has it, `INVOICE_IN_PROGRESS`;
once invoiced, it needs a credit note (`CREDIT_NOTE_REQUIRED`), which
the public API doesn't issue yet. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

post.description:
An access token for an integration client: 15 minutes, no refresh
(it asks again with its credentials). Its claims carry the tenant
(`tid`), the client (`azp`), the `scope` granted and the branches it is
limited to (`bids`). Answers follow RFC 6749, not the API envelope.

InvoiceStatus.title: InvoiceStatus
InvoiceStatus.description:
Factura de la venta en faclab-invoicing; sin valor, no se envió.

PENDING desde que su `sales.confirmed` llega al outbox (al confirmar o
reenviar), REJECTED cuando el SRI la rechaza (con el motivo), AUTHORIZED
cuando la autoriza (la venta pasa a INVOICED) y CREDITED cuando sus notas de
crédito la acreditan por completo (S4.5).
